trait_descriptions: length_growth = increase in shoot length (mm / yr)
max_ht = maximal attainable height of the species
leaf_area_sapwood_area = fresh leaf area divided by sapwood cross-sectional area measured on 1-cm diameter shoot (m2 / cm2)
Ks = sapwood-specific conductivity (kg / m / s / MPa)
leaf_size = size of a single fresh leaf (cm2)
Aarea = maximal light-saturated net CO2 assimilation rate (micro-moles / m2 / s)
leaf_N = dry leaf nitrogen concentration (mg / g)
LMA = dry leaf mass divided by fresh leaf area (g / m2)
leaf_SWC = fresh leaf water mass divided by dry leaf mass (unitless)
dia_40cm = the over-bark diameter of a 40-cm long shoot (mm)
measured_ht = height of trees/shrubs measured in the study  (m)
